Data Science.required_education: Master's or Bachelor's in Computer Science, Data Science, or related field
Data Science.jd_text: We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Scientist to architect predictive analytics and machine learning solutions. You will extract actionable business insights from vast data repositories, design statistical models, and collaborate with engineering teams to deploy models into production. Required skills include Python, SQL, Scikit-learn, Pandas, statistical modeling, hypothesis testing, and data visualization. Hands-on experience with deep learning, PyTorch, or Docker is a strong plus.

Machine Learning.required_education: B.Tech/M.Tech/M.S. in Computer Science, AI, or equivalent
Machine Learning.jd_text: Join our AI team as a Machine Learning Engineer to design, train, and optimize state-of-the-art deep learning models for production scale. You will work on natural language processing, computer vision, and transformer architectures. Strong programming in Python, PyTorch or TensorFlow, containerization with Docker, and building resilient model-serving APIs are mandatory.

Web Development.required_education: Bachelor's in Computer Science or Software Engineering
Web Development.jd_text: Looking for a passionate Lead Full Stack Web Developer proficient in modern frontend and backend architectures. You will lead the development of enterprise web applications using React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, and relational databases. Must possess deep expertise in responsive web design, RESTful APIs, state management, and high-performance server-side rendering.

DevOps & Cloud.required_education: Bachelor's in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent experience
DevOps & Cloud.jd_text: Seeking a Senior DevOps & Cloud Architect to automate and secure our cloud infrastructure. You will manage container orchestration with Kubernetes, implement Infrastructure as Code via Terraform, maintain zero-downtime CI/CD deployment pipelines, and optimize cloud costs across AWS. Strong Linux systems administration and bash scripting are essential.

Java Development.required_education: B.Tech / M.Tech in Computer Science or related discipline
Java Development.jd_text: We are looking for a Principal Java Developer to design scalable distributed microservices handling millions of daily transactions. Must possess deep mastery over Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, Kafka event streaming, and relational database systems. Experience with multi-threading, concurrency, and cloud-native deployments is strongly required.

Cybersecurity.required_education: B.Tech in CS/Cybersecurity or recognized industry certifications (CISSP, CEH)
Cybersecurity.jd_text: Seeking an Information Security Analyst to safeguard enterprise networks and digital assets. Responsible for conducting penetration tests, managing SIEM alerts, vulnerability assessments, and threat intelligence analysis. Strong knowledge of firewalls, Wireshark, OWASP security principles, and incident response frameworks required.
